title: Glomar Explorer recovers a sunken Soviet submarine

tellings.quote: Yeah. This huge corporation, they actually recovered a sunken Soviet submarine in the 1970s and it was an incredible feat

plain: In the 1970s, a ship called the Glomar Explorer pulled a sunken Soviet submarine up from the floor of the Pacific Ocean. The researcher Richard Dolan tells Michels that 'this huge corporation' did it, naming Howard Hughes and a company called Global Marine Corporation, and calls it 'an incredible feat'. He offers it without naming a source, as an example of how big a secret recovery a private company can carry out for the government.
